name: Monzuka! Atsumero! Monmusu Zukan
original_name: もんずか!あつめろ!もんむす図鑑
source:
A mysterious doctor asked you to make a list of monster girls!
He said there are 6 species of wild monster girls on Forecock isle.

Succubus, slime, dragon, mermaid, fairy and Catoblepas...!?
They are girls but monsters at the same time!

Observe them carefully to find their weak spots!
You can do whatever you want to them after you win the battle!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE239119.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一名神秘医生请你制作一份怪物女孩图鉴！
他说，福尔考克岛上生活着6种野生怪物女孩。

魅魔、史莱姆、龙、人鱼、妖精和卡托布莱帕斯……！？
她们是女孩，同时也是怪物！

仔细观察她们，找出弱点！
战斗获胜后，你可以对她们做任何事！

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE239119.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
